scope: Generated LAYER table writer whole-operation allocation rollback, retry, and typed readback across supported DXF writer revisions.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored DRW_Layer generated by the test
source.profile: Named layer with flags, ACI color, truecolor, CONTINUOUS linetype, plot flag, lineweight, and R2007+ color name.

implementation.method: Calibrate each generated whole-file write; inject std::bad_alloc at every measured allocation inside the direct LAYER callback; require the existing destination sentinel and caller record to remain unchanged; retry on the same codec and require byte-identical clean output plus a fresh typed LAYER readback. Version-specific fields are compared only where the target DXF revision emits them.

validation.directControl: build-gcc/tests/libdxfrw_layer_table_allocation_tests: PASS; seven revisions, both encodings, all 164 measured offsets

limitations: Generated DXF codec transaction and modeled typed readback evidence only; this does not qualify producer-authored LAYER semantics or full source/output reference closure.
Native layer presentation and cross-consumer behavior remain unqualified.
This libdxfrw writer control does not implement LibreCAD PR #3269's separate RS_FilterDXFRW reconciliation of edited LC_LineType definitions against archived DRW_LType records.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
